title: Founding commitment to the Cooperative AI Foundation
description: $15M commitment that seeded the Cooperative AI Foundation, made in May 2021 as the Center for Emerging Risk Research (later Polaris Ventures, now Macroscopic Ventures). A multi-year commitment recorded as one grant. CAIF's own grants are netted against it.

title: Foundations of Cooperative AI Lab (FOCAL)
description: $3M commitment to Carnegie Mellon University to establish the Foundations of Cooperative AI Lab headed by Vincent Conitzer, announced February 2022 (given as the Center for Emerging Risk Research). Listed on macroscopic.org/grants.
